title: Monthly revenue
description: How does delivered revenue trend month over month?
sql:
-- How does delivered revenue trend month over month?
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

title: Top customers
description: Who are the top 10 customers by lifetime delivered revenue?
sql:
-- Who are the top 10 customers by lifetime delivered revenue?
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS lifetime_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

title: Category performance
description: Which product categories drive revenue and units sold?
sql:
-- Which product categories drive revenue and units sold?
SELECT
    p.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) /
        (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items i2
         JOIN orders o2 ON o2.order_id = i2.order_id AND o2.status = 'delivered'), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

title: Region analysis
description: How do regions compare on revenue, customers and average order value?
sql:
-- How do regions compare on revenue, customers and average order value?
SELECT
    c.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

title: Repeat purchase rate
description: What share of customers placed more than one order?
sql:
-- What share of customers placed more than one order?
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
    FROM orders
    WHERE status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM order_counts;

title: Cancel return rates
description: How healthy is fulfillment? Order counts and rates by status.
sql:
-- How healthy is fulfillment? Order counts and rates by status.
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 1) AS pct_of_orders
FROM orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY orders DESC;

title: Top products
description: Which 10 products sell the most units, and what revenue do they bring?
sql:
-- Which 10 products sell the most units, and what revenue do they bring?
SELECT
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

title: Customer cohort revenue
description: Do older customer cohorts (by signup quarter) spend more?
sql:
-- Do older customer cohorts (by signup quarter) spend more?
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', c.signup_date) || '-Q' ||
        ((CAST(strftime('%m', c.signup_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS signup_quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY signup_quarter
ORDER BY signup_quarter;

title: Running total revenue
description: Running (cumulative) delivered revenue by month, with each month's share of the total. Window functions: SUM() OVER (ORDER BY ...), SUM() OVER ()
sql:
-- Running (cumulative) delivered revenue by month, with each month's share of the total.
-- Window functions: SUM() OVER (ORDER BY ...), SUM() OVER ()
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

title: Mom growth
description: Month-over-month revenue growth and 3-month moving average. Window functions: LAG(), AVG() OVER (ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
sql:
-- Month-over-month revenue growth and 3-month moving average.
-- Window functions: LAG(), AVG() OVER (ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS prev_month_revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
             / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 1) AS mom_growth_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

title: Top products per category
description: Top 3 products by revenue inside each category. Window function: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC)
sql:
-- Top 3 products by revenue inside each category.
-- Window function: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC)
WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT p.category,
           p.product_name,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, product_name, revenue,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS category_rank
    FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT category, category_rank, product_name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank;

title: Customer spend deciles
description: Split customers into 10 spend deciles (1 = biggest spenders) and show how concentrated revenue is. Window function: NTILE(10)
sql:
-- Split customers into 10 spend deciles (1 = biggest spenders) and show how
-- concentrated revenue is. Window function: NTILE(10)
WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS spend
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
deciles AS (
    SELECT customer_id, spend,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY spend DESC) AS spend_decile
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT spend_decile,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(spend) / (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM customer_spend), 1) AS pct_of_revenue,
       ROUND(MIN(spend), 2) AS min_spend,
       ROUND(MAX(spend), 2) AS max_spend
FROM deciles
GROUP BY spend_decile
ORDER BY spend_decile;

title: Days between orders
description: Average days between consecutive orders per repeat customer. Window function: LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)
sql:
-- Average days between consecutive orders per repeat customer.
-- Window function: LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)
WITH gaps AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           order_date,
           julianday(order_date)
             - julianday(LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id)) AS days_since_prev
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
)
SELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(days_since_prev) AS repeat_orders,
       ROUND(AVG(days_since_prev), 1) AS avg_days_between_orders,
       MIN(days_since_prev) AS shortest_gap,
       MAX(days_since_prev) AS longest_gap
FROM gaps
WHERE days_since_prev IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY repeat_orders DESC, avg_days_between_orders
LIMIT 20;

title: First and latest order
description: For every customer: first order, latest order, and order count, using ROW_NUMBER() to pick the first and latest rows. Shows the 20 most recent first orders.
sql:
-- For every customer: first order, latest order, and order count, using
-- ROW_NUMBER() to pick the first and latest rows. Shows the 20 most recent first orders.
WITH numbered AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id) AS rn_first,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn_last,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS total_orders
    FROM orders o
)
SELECT f.customer_id,
       f.order_date AS first_order_date,
       l.order_date AS latest_order_date,
       f.total_orders,
       CAST(julianday(l.order_date) - julianday(f.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS customer_lifetime_days
FROM numbered f
JOIN numbered l ON l.customer_id = f.customer_id AND l.rn_last = 1
WHERE f.rn_first = 1
ORDER BY f.order_date DESC, f.customer_id
LIMIT 20;

title: Region share and rank
description: Each region's revenue, share of company revenue and rank, plus the gap to the leader. Window functions: RANK(), SUM() OVER (), FIRST_VALUE()
sql:
-- Each region's revenue, share of company revenue and rank, plus the gap to the leader.
-- Window functions: RANK(), SUM() OVER (), FIRST_VALUE()
WITH region_revenue AS (
    SELECT c.region,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'delivered'
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.region
)
SELECT region,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total,
       ROUND(revenue - FIRST_VALUE(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC), 2) AS gap_to_leader
FROM region_revenue
ORDER BY revenue_rank;

title: Customer retention by quarter
description: Quarterly active customers and how many of them were also active the previous quarter. Uses a self-join on a CTE plus LAG() for the quarter-over-quarter change.
sql:
-- Quarterly active customers and how many of them were also active the previous quarter.
-- Uses a self-join on a CTE plus LAG() for the quarter-over-quarter change.
WITH active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id,
           strftime('%Y', o.order_date) || '-Q' ||
               ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
),
per_quarter AS (
    SELECT quarter, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM active GROUP BY quarter
),
retained AS (
    SELECT cur.quarter,
           COUNT(*) AS retained_customers
    FROM active cur
    JOIN active prev
      ON prev.customer_id = cur.customer_id
     AND prev.quarter = (
            CASE
              WHEN substr(cur.quarter, 7, 1) = '1'
                THEN CAST(CAST(substr(cur.quarter, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 1 AS TEXT) || '-Q4'
              ELSE substr(cur.quarter, 1, 6) || CAST(CAST(substr(cur.quarter, 7, 1) AS INTEGER) - 1 AS TEXT)
            END)
    GROUP BY cur.quarter
)
SELECT p.quarter,
       p.active_customers,
       COALESCE(r.retained_customers, 0) AS retained_from_prev_quarter,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.retained_customers, 0) / LAG(p.active_customers) OVER (ORDER BY p.quarter), 1) AS retention_pct,
       p.active_customers - LAG(p.active_customers) OVER (ORDER BY p.quarter) AS change_vs_prev_quarter
FROM per_quarter p
LEFT JOIN retained r ON r.quarter = p.quarter
ORDER BY p.quarter;

title: Customer lifetime value
description: Customer lifetime value so far: delivered revenue, orders, average order value and active days for each customer, with a value tier. Window function: NTILE(4)
sql:
-- Customer lifetime value so far: delivered revenue, orders, average order value and
-- active days for each customer, with a value tier. Window function: NTILE(4)
WITH per_order AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS order_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date
),
per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           COUNT(*) AS orders,
           ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS lifetime_value,
           ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value,
           CAST(julianday(MAX(order_date)) - julianday(MIN(order_date)) AS INTEGER) AS active_days
    FROM per_order
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, orders, lifetime_value, avg_order_value, active_days,
       CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Top 25%' WHEN 2 THEN 'Upper middle'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Lower middle' ELSE 'Bottom 25%' END AS value_tier
FROM per_customer
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC;

title: Products bought together
description: Which pairs of products are ordered together most often? Self-join on order_items. Only orders that are not cancelled are counted.
sql:
-- Which pairs of products are ordered together most often? Self-join on order_items.
-- Only orders that are not cancelled are counted.
SELECT p1.product_name AS product_a,
       p2.product_name AS product_b,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_together
FROM order_items a
JOIN order_items b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = a.order_id AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
JOIN products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id
ORDER BY orders_together DESC, product_a, product_b
LIMIT 15;

title: Customers at risk
description: Repeat customers who have gone quiet: at least 2 delivered orders, and no order of any status in the 90 days before the last order date in the data.
sql:
-- Repeat customers who have gone quiet: at least 2 delivered orders, and no order of
-- any status in the 90 days before the last order date in the data.
WITH last_day AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS d FROM orders),
delivered AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
    FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
latest AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS last_order FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.region, d.delivered_orders, l.last_order,
       CAST(julianday((SELECT d FROM last_day)) - julianday(l.last_order) AS INTEGER) AS days_since_last_order
FROM delivered d
JOIN latest l ON l.customer_id = d.customer_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
WHERE julianday((SELECT d FROM last_day)) - julianday(l.last_order) > 90
ORDER BY d.delivered_orders DESC, days_since_last_order DESC
LIMIT 25;

title: Basket size and value
description: How does order value change with the number of line items in the basket?
sql:
-- How does order value change with the number of line items in the basket?
WITH basket AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           COUNT(*) AS line_items,
           SUM(i.quantity) AS units,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS order_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT line_items,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basket), 1) AS pct_of_orders,
       ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avg_units,
       ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM basket
GROUP BY line_items
ORDER BY line_items;

title: Category mix by region
description: Share of each region's delivered revenue that comes from each category (a pivot with CASE).
sql:
-- Share of each region's delivered revenue that comes from each category (a pivot with CASE).
WITH rev AS (
    SELECT c.region, p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.region, p.category
)
SELECT region,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue), 0) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Electronics' THEN revenue END) / SUM(revenue), 1) AS electronics_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Books' THEN revenue END) / SUM(revenue), 1) AS books_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN category NOT IN ('Electronics', 'Books') THEN revenue END) / SUM(revenue), 1) AS other_pct
FROM rev
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
